facts.value: System software is software that directly operates the computer hardware and provides the basic functionality to the users as well as to other software to operate smoothly.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: System software basically controls a computer’s internal functioning and also controls hardware devices such as monitors, printers, and storage devices.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: It is like an interface between hardware and user applications, helping them to communicate with each other because hardware understands machine language (i.e., 1 or 0) whereas user applications work in human-readable languages like English, Hindi, German, etc.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Closer to the computer system.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Written in a low-level language in general.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Difficult to design and understand.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Fast in speed.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: Less interactive for the users in comparison to application software.

metadata.chunk_title: 1. System Software + Features of System Software

facts.value: It is the main program of a computer system. When the computer system is turned on, the operating system is the first software loaded into memory. Basically, it manages all the resources such as computer memory, CPU, printer, hard disk, etc., and provides an interface to the user, which helps the user to interact with the computer system.

metadata.chunk_title: Types of System Software

facts.value: As we know that system software converts the human-readable language into a machine language and vice versa. So, the conversion is done by the language processor. It converts programs written in high-level programming languages like Java, C, C++, Python, etc. (known as source code), into sets of instructions that are easily readable by machines (known as object code or machine code).

metadata.chunk_title: Types of System Software

facts.value: A device driver is a program or software that controls a device and helps that device to perform its functions. It enables the operating system to communicate with and control external hardware devices connected to the computer. Example: Printer, mouse, modem, etc.

metadata.chunk_title: Types of System Software

facts.value: This type of application software is used to support the computer infrastructure. Utility software analyzes, configures, optimizes, and maintains the computer system to ensure efficient performance. Example: Antivirus, disk defragmenter, memory tester, disk repair, disk cleaners, registry cleaners, disk space analyzer, etc.

metadata.chunk_title: Types of System Software

facts.value: Software that performs special functions or provides functions that are much more than the basic operation of the computer.

metadata.chunk_title: 2. Application Software + Features of Application Software

facts.value: Designed to perform a specific task for end-users.

metadata.chunk_title: 2. Application Software + Features of Application Software

facts.value: Word processors, spreadsheets, database management, inventory, payroll programs, etc.

metadata.chunk_title: 2. Application Software + Features of Application Software

facts.value: Perform more specialized tasks like word processing, spreadsheets, email, etc.

metadata.chunk_title: 2. Application Software + Features of Application Software

facts.value: Mostly, the size of the software is big, so it requires more storage space.

metadata.chunk_title: 2. Application Software + Features of Application Software

facts.value: More interactive for the users, so it is easy to use and design.

metadata.chunk_title: 2. Application Software + Features of Application Software

facts.value: Easy to design and understand.

metadata.chunk_title: 2. Application Software + Features of Application Software

facts.value: Written in a high-level language in general.
